composites.description: MAPK signalling cycle as a Milner-style Bigraphical Reactive System. MEK phosphorylates ERK in the cytoplasm; phospho-ERK translocates through the nuclear pore into the nucleus; nuclear phosphatases close the cycle. Seven redex → reactum rewrite rules fire under Gillespie SSA over a nested cell bigraph (Cell ⊃ Cytoplasm ⊃ {Nucleus, ERLumen}).
